title: Replace CloudWatch logging with stdout for K8s log capture

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: **Context:** K8s MVP scoring path (scoring_api.py, scoring_job.py, TactusScore.py) already uses stdlib logging (logging.getLogger) — no CloudWatch dependency was ever wired in. However, best practice requires: (1) explicit PLEXUS_DISABLE_CLOUDWATCH_LOGS=1 in Helm values as defensive guard against transitive imports, (2) explicit logging.basicConfig in scoring_api lifespan for structured output, (3) verification that kubectl logs captures scoring worker output. This is a hardening chore, not a migration — CloudWatch code remains for AWS production path.
